title: 童趣插画
prompt: Create a full body, flat vector illustration of [CHARACTER] in a whimsical, wavy cartoon style. Use thin black outlines and smooth, rounded shapes. The character should have a tiny white-colored head with tiny dot eyes and a simple nose and mouth. The body should have exaggerated, playful proportions. Use bold, flat colors for the clothing. No gradients. No shading. No smudging. Place the character on a solid blue background. Vector friendly. Square aspect ratio.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 创作充满童趣的扁平矢量插画，以俏皮风格设计卡通角色，适合儿童时尚、品牌形象和车辆装饰，用鲜明色彩和纯色背景打造吸睛的视觉作品。
